Visiting Pinball Engine
-------------------------

You are very welcomed to visit our office, but please make an appointment in advance so we can prepare any information you may need as well as making sure we are in the office to meet with you. 

If catching the MTR, please exit Mong Kok station C4 exit and follow Argyle St to our building.
